title: Đếm quan hệ theo loại (chỉ dữ liệu của dự án)
cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.scope_id = 'nlpgraph-v1' RETURN type(r) AS relation, count(r) AS total ORDER BY total DESC

title: Cặp đồng tác giả viết chung nhiều bài nhất, kèm paper chứng cứ
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[c:COAUTHORED_WITH]->(b:Author) WHERE c.scope_id = 'nlpgraph-v1' RETURN a.name AS author_a, b.name AS author_b, c.shared_count AS shared, c.evidence_paper_ids AS papers ORDER BY shared DESC, author_a LIMIT 5

title: Truy ngược: hai tác giả viết chung bài nào, mỗi người khai báo tổ chức nào trên bài đó, bài thuộc topic gì
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[c:COAUTHORED_WITH]->(b:Author) WHERE c.scope_id = 'nlpgraph-v1' AND c.shared_count >= 2 WITH a, b, c ORDER BY c.shared_count DESC, a.id LIMIT 1 UNWIND c.evidence_paper_ids AS pid MATCH (p:Paper {id: pid}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[fa:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(ia:Institution) WHERE pid IN fa.evidence_paper_ids OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[fb:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(ib:Institution) WHERE pid IN fb.evidence_paper_ids OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_TOPIC]->(t:Topic) RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b, p.title AS paper, p.source_url AS url, collect(DISTINCT ia.name) AS inst_a, collect(DISTINCT ib.name) AS inst_b, collect(DISTINCT t.topic_key) AS topics

title: Trích dẫn nội bộ corpus (X CITES Y)
cypher: MATCH (p:Paper)-[c:CITES]->(q:Paper) WHERE c.scope_id = 'nlpgraph-v1' RETURN p.title AS citing, q.title AS cited, c.source_url AS evidence ORDER BY citing LIMIT 5

title: Tổ chức hoạt động nhiều nhất theo topic (ACTIVE_IN)
cypher: MATCH (i:Institution)-[r:ACTIVE_IN]->(t:Topic) WHERE r.scope_id = 'nlpgraph-v1' RETURN i.name AS institution, t.topic_key AS topic, r.evidence_count AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC, institution LIMIT 8
